F004: Section A-A locates the recess floor .500 below the OD crown. Cutting outward from that floor with depth D010 overshoots the curved outside surface. The recess is centered transversely, but its axial position is independently dimensioned and is not forced concentric with the inner opening.

F005: The leader identifies the inner opening. The outer recess is drawn with rounded corners, but its radius is not independently specified. F007: For the D018 nominal .500 SHCS, the supplied ASME B18.3 normal-fit chart specifies .531 drill and .812 counterbore diameter. The printed D017 overrides the chart's usual counterbore depth. F008: A 3/8-16 UNC thread uses a standard 5/16 inch (.3125) tap drill. Model the printed tapped depth as a flat-bottom nominal threaded bore, with threads cosmetic and no invented drill-point allowance. End-view coordinates are measured from the shaft axis, not the bounding-box corner.
